title: A hypothetical eight-GPU weekly ledger
method: Eight GPUs ×168 hours=1,344 gross GPU-hours. Exclusive synthetic categories sum to1,344. Execution/gross=53.6%; execution/(gross-maintenance)=62.5%. Execution time is not arithmetic efficiency, and reclaimed committed capacity is not automatically cash savings.
alt: A hypothetical eight-GPU weekly ledger. Executing workloads: 720 GPU-hours, Allocated idle: 240 GPU-hours, Serving headroom: 192 GPU-hours, Maintenance: 192 GPU-hours. Illustrative data.
